executiveLeadership.name: K. Srinivasa Rao (KSR Sir)
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: Institutional leadership, administrative governance, multi-campus expansion across Bhavans, disciplinary frameworks, and philanthropic trust scholarships.
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Institutional Chairman of Oxford VIT and founding head of the KSR Charitable Trust.
executiveLeadership.biography: Distinguished institutional leader and educator with 30 years of impactful leadership in pre-university education and IIT Mathematics pedagogy. As Chairman and head of the KSR Charitable Trust, he oversees institutional discipline, modern infrastructure development across all Bhavans, and awards annual merit-cum-means scholarships to deserving achievers.

executiveLeadership.name: D. Srinivasa Rao (DSR Sir)
executiveLeadership.specialization: Senior IIT Mathematics Mentor and Academic Planning
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: Institutional leadership, central academic planning, IIT-JEE Super Wing curriculum synchronization, weekly cumulative testing architecture, and faculty mentoring.
executiveLeadership.additionalRole: Chief Academic Council Chairperson & National Test Analyst
executiveLeadership.verificationStatus: Verified Chairman & Chief Academic Council Chair (Ex-SRA, IIT Delhi)
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Institutional Chairman of Oxford VIT leading senior curriculum planning, IIT-JEE Super Wing direction, and competitive examination strategy.
executiveLeadership.biography: Accomplished institutional leader, mathematician, and academic planner with 32 years of teaching distinction, bringing elite research discipline from his background as an Ex-Senior Research Assistant (Ex-SRA) at IIT Delhi. As Chairman, he architects Oxford VIT's rigorous weekly test models, Super Wing curricula, and personalized error-analysis clinics.
executiveLeadership.primaryCampus: Raman Bhavan (IIT-JEE Super Wing) & Main Campus

executiveLeadership.name: Ch. Raja Reddy
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: Institutional strategy, inter-campus operational synergy across Narasaraopet, Guntur, and Bapatla, student amenities, and resource optimization.
executiveLeadership.verificationStatus: Verified Director — Institutional Strategy & Campus Operations
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Oversees operational harmonization between the operational Bhavans, sister schools, and regional branches.
executiveLeadership.biography: Dynamic institutional strategist steering the multi-location operational architecture of Oxford VIT. Focuses on seamless resource allocation, world-class classroom technology, transportation safety, and high-standard campus infrastructure throughout Palnadu, Guntur, and Bapatla.

executiveLeadership.name: P.V. Ranga Rao
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: Direction of chemical sciences curriculum, NEET & JEE Advanced chemistry mastery cohorts, laboratory practicals standardization, and analytical testing.
executiveLeadership.additionalRole: Dean of Chemical Sciences & Competitive Research
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Directs chemistry pedagogy and scientific laboratory standards across all campuses.
executiveLeadership.biography: Distinguished chemist and educator from IIT Roorkee with 19 years of classroom and competitive mentorship. Celebrated for deconstructing complex organic reaction mechanisms and physical chemistry numerical models, guiding hundreds of students into top-tier IITs, NITs, and AIIMS.

executiveLeadership.name: Panadi Raghava
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: Campus academic administration, classroom curriculum delivery, student motivation, parent-faculty liaison, and day-to-day scholastic discipline.
executiveLeadership.additionalRole: KSR Charitable Trust Volunteer & Youth Mentor
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Active educational counselor with verified social outreach on Instagram (@raghava_vit) and Threads.
executiveLeadership.biography: Vibrant academic leader, acclaimed mathematics teacher, and youth motivational orator with 19 years of devotion to intermediate students. Serves concurrently as Principal, Super-60 mentor, and enthusiastic KSR Charitable Trust volunteer, fostering ethical conviction alongside academic excellence.

executiveLeadership.name: K. Sambasiva Rao
executiveLeadership.responsibilities: On-ground campus administration in Narasaraopet, hostel logistics, transportation fleet scheduling, and student welfare services.
executiveLeadership.affiliationNote: Directs daily facility maintenance, student transit safety, and hostel mess nutrition in Narasaraopet.
executiveLeadership.biography: Dedicated operational manager ensuring the flawless execution of day-to-day student welfare and infrastructure services. Oversees the 35+ campus bus transit grid, residential dining hygiene, hostel maintenance, and physical security across Narasaraopet facilities.
